thread:
sam_runtime: Heads-up — kernel v3.14.2 + quant-v2 build will be staged in eu-west-1 in 30m. rolling canary 5% -> 25% over 40m. Please watch p95 and inference_error_rate.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: kernel:3.14.2 quant:quant-v2 staging:euw1 canary=[5,25] window=40m. runbooks: /runbooks/runtime-upgrade. @tia_sre tagged.

kevin_build: Uploading wheel and container now. Image sha: sha256:ab3f.. ETA 10m.

anya_qc: I'll queue perf microbench and smoke. Tests: latency_p95, mem_leak, kvcache_integrity.

maria_release: Adding a short blurb to release notes; need a non-breaking summary. Anyone want to add callouts?

sam_runtime: Callouts: quant-v2 changes low-bit matmul kernels; might change token latency variance. Mention pinning option for Dedicated customers.

tia_sre: I'll standby for rollback signal. Criteria: if inference_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 20% sustained for 10m -> trigger automatic pin & rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary started (5%): hosts affected: runtime-canary-eu-01..04. Status: deploying -> pulling images.

ops_bot: Alert rule deployed: runtime.canary.p95 and runtime.canary.errors. Notified: #eng-oncall, @tia_sre.

kevin_build: Build artifacts pushed: s3://redwood-artifacts/runtime/3.14.2/quant-v2/{image,checksum}.sha. Command used:

``n
bazel build //runtime:engine --config=quant-v2 && docker push ...
``n
anya_qc: Perf run: p95 baseline 48ms -> canary 52ms (+8%), p99 baseline 130ms -> canary 160ms (+23%). Memory flat. No obvious leaks in 10m.

sam_runtime: Not ideal on p99. Tia, you want to pause and expand canary or proceed?

tia_sre: Pause. Increase canary to 10% and rerun perf sweep across longer tails. Also enable more verbose kvcache logs for 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 10% as requested. Re-running smoke and perf suites.

maria_release: I'll hold release notes; mark as "needs perf follow-up".

anya_qc: After 10% run: p99 now 145ms (+11%) — looks better trend. No new errors.

sam_runtime: OK — proceed to 25% over next 20m. Keep pin TTL at 6h if we need to pin for dedicated.

tia_sre: Reminder: if we end up pinning, include rollback reason + zip of smoke logs in ticket. I'll prepare the pin request template.

deploy-bot: Canary at 25%. Monitoring.

ops_bot: Metric snapshot attached: p95/p99/err_rate graphs + deploy tag. @sam_runtime @tia_sre

kevin_build: Noted. If we need to roll back, we have image 3.14.1 ready to un-swap.

sam_runtime: Thanks everyone. After 60m final check we'll schedule cross-region roll if stable. If any regression, we'll pin + rollback quick. :thumbsup:
